name: Clear Windows Error Reporting Files
description: Removes old Windows Error Reporting files to free up disk space without disabling crash reporting features.

description_i18n.en: Removes old Windows Error Reporting files to free up disk space without disabling crash reporting features.
description_i18n.de: Entfernt alte Windows-Error-Reporting-Dateien, um Speicherplatz zu sparen, ohne die Absturzmeldungsfunktionen auszuschalten.
description_i18n.fr: Supprime les anciens fichiers de rapport d'erreurs pour libérer de l'espace disque sans désactiver la fonctionnalité de signalement des plantages.

warnings.title: Lost crash data
warnings.message: Deleted error reports cannot be used later for troubleshooting application crashes, driver problems, or system stability issues. Do not run this cleanup if you are actively diagnosing recent crashes

warnings.title: Local data cleanup
warnings.message: Cache or temporary data may be removed. Windows or apps may take a moment to rebuild it

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Deletes existing crash reports, diagnostic metadata, queued reports, and archived data from standard WER locations in ProgramData and LocalAppData The action does not disable the Windows Error Reporting service or prevent new report generation
